children.name: text
children.text: FEATURES

children.name: text
children.text: Every feature you need to run a fleet of game servers

children.name: text
children.text: From provisioning to backups, RBAC to observability — a closer look at how each piece works.

children.name: text
children.text: Kubernetes-native by design

children.name: text
children.text: Nine purpose-built Custom Resource Definitions — GameServer, GameTemplate, Cluster, Backup, BackupSchedule, Restore, Module, ModuleSource, and NetworkCapture — are reconciled by a single controller-runtime operator. Whether you create a server through the dashboard or with kubectl apply, the outcome is identical: the operator is the single source of truth.

children.name: text
children.text: Scales from homelab to production

children.name: text
children.text: The exact same CRDs, controllers, and Helm chart that run on a single-node k3s homelab also run on a multi-node production cluster. There's no separate 'production mode' to migrate to — StatefulSets, PVCs, and rolling upgrades from day one. The dashboard and API can also run standalone on Docker Compose; games still need a registered cluster. (v0.4.0)

children.name: text
children.text: Live console & RCON

children.name: text
children.text: An in-pod agent sidecar streams the console over WebSocket and speaks each game's native protocol — Source RCON, telnet, Rust WebRcon, BattlEye, or a REST admin API — no SSH, no kubectl exec, no separate client required.

children.name: text
children.text: In-browser file manager

children.name: text
children.text: Browse, edit, upload, and download files on a running server's data volume straight from the dashboard, with a full Monaco editor — the same engine behind VS Code — for config files, scripts, and datapacks.

children.name: text
children.text: Backups & one-click restore

children.name: text
children.text: Scheduled or on-demand snapshots are pushed to any S3-compatible storage backend using restic, giving you deduplicated, encrypted, incremental backups. Restoring is a single click from the dashboard's Backups tab. A stopped server with several data volumes can be recovered from its restic backups. (v0.4.0)

children.name: text
children.text: Game module system

children.name: text
children.text: Twenty-nine games ship out of the box, and the open template format supports any game with a config file and a start command.

children.name: text
children.text: RBAC + OIDC auth

children.name: text
children.text: Authenticate with local accounts or federate through OIDC — Keycloak, Authentik, Google, Okta, or Entra ID. Three built-in roles (admin, operator, viewer) scope access per namespace, so a shared cluster can host multiple teams safely. Only full administrators can grant admin-level permissions. (v0.4.0)

children.name: text
children.text: Audit logging & observability

children.name: text
children.text: Every mutating API request is logged to the database and exportable as CSV or JSON, with optional mirroring to stdout, a webhook, or syslog. Fleet-wide Prometheus metrics and a bundled Grafana dashboard come from the same install.
